status: PROPOSED ONLY - not yet created or verified in Jira
scenario: Airport Lost Luggage Claim & Tracking Portal
scenario_source: SELABS README and Lab 3 architecture justification; Lab 1 requirements were not available.

epics.description: Allow passengers and baggage agents to access the portal with appropriate permissions.
Allow passengers to register and review lost luggage claims.
Help agents trace baggage and let passengers follow claim progress.
Notify passengers of updates and support compensation requests.

stories.description: As a passenger, I want to sign in securely, so that I can access my own luggage claims.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Valid credentials allow access; invalid credentials are rejected; passengers cannot read another passenger's claims.

stories.description: As a passenger, I want to submit my flight, baggage tag and contact details, so that I can report a missing bag.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Required fields are validated; a valid submission creates a unique claim reference; the passenger sees confirmation.

stories.description: As a passenger, I want to view my submitted claims and their status, so that I can check the progress of my reports.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Only the signed-in passenger's claims are listed; each shows its reference and current status; an empty list is handled.

stories.description: As a baggage agent, I want to access the agent dashboard using my assigned role, so that I can manage claims securely.
stories.acceptance_criteria: An authorized agent can open the dashboard; a passenger cannot access agent actions; unauthorized requests are rejected.

stories.description: As a baggage agent, I want to search scan records by baggage tag, so that I can locate a reported missing bag.
stories.acceptance_criteria: An existing tag returns ordered scan records; an unknown tag shows no results; each scan shows location and time.

stories.description: As a baggage agent, I want to update a claim as its bag is located and returned, so that I can keep the passenger informed.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Authorized agents can update status; invalid transitions are rejected; the change records the agent and timestamp.

stories.description: As a passenger, I want to view the tracking timeline of my bag, so that I can see its last known location.
stories.acceptance_criteria: The timeline shows available scans in time order; unavailable tracking is explained; access is restricted to the claim owner.

stories.description: As a passenger, I want to receive a notification when my claim status changes, so that I can learn about updates without repeatedly checking.
stories.acceptance_criteria: A status change queues a notification for the claim owner; delivery failures are recorded for retry; duplicate handling avoids repeated messages for the same update.

stories.description: As a passenger, I want to attach supporting documents to my claim, so that I can provide the details needed to process it.
stories.acceptance_criteria: The claim owner can attach a supported file; oversized or unsupported files are rejected; other passengers cannot access the attachment.

stories.description: As a passenger, I want to submit a compensation request for an eligible claim, so that I can request reimbursement for my loss.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Eligibility is checked; a valid request receives a reference and pending status; a duplicate request for the same claim is rejected.

sprint_plan.name: Sprint 1
sprint_plan.goal: Register and view luggage claims with passenger and agent access.

sprint_plan.name: Sprint 2
sprint_plan.goal: Trace bags, update claims and notify passengers.
